findings.contract: An in-flight repeated extraction must not dispatch a second provider operation under one quota reservation.
findings.observed: Two simultaneous same-request actual handler calls reach the controlled provider twice with one actual SQL reservation; expected one dispatch.
findings.rootCause: Quota RPC returns allowed=true for duplicate_replay and the handler adapter drops the replay reason, interpreting reuse as a fresh dispatch grant.
findings.repairPlan: Refuse in-flight duplicate dispatch with bounded retry response, keep original reservation untouched; regression proves one provider call/one reservation and original completion.
